name: rim
expr: max(3.5 mm, if(magnets, 12.1 mm, 0 mm), if(bowtie, 6.85 mm + 1 * clr, 0 mm), if(dove, 8.85 mm + 1 * clr, 0 mm))

name: k0x
expr: floor((bed - fx - if(conn == 2, 8 mm, 0 mm)) / grid)

name: p0x
expr: if(cx * grid + 2 * fx <= bed, 1, max(2, ceil(cx / k0x)))

name: k0y
expr: floor((bed - fy - if(conn == 2, 8 mm, 0 mm)) / grid)

name: p0y
expr: if(cy * grid + 2 * fy <= bed, 1, max(2, ceil(cy / k0y)))

name: wx0
expr: if(px == 1, Wx, if(0 == 0, fx + kx * grid, if(0 == px - 1, lx * grid + fx, kx * grid)))

name: wx1
expr: if(px == 1, Wx, if(1 == 0, fx + kx * grid, if(1 == px - 1, lx * grid + fx, kx * grid)))

name: wx2
expr: if(px == 1, Wx, if(2 == 0, fx + kx * grid, if(2 == px - 1, lx * grid + fx, kx * grid)))

name: wx3
expr: if(px == 1, Wx, if(3 == 0, fx + kx * grid, if(3 == px - 1, lx * grid + fx, kx * grid)))

name: wx4
expr: if(px == 1, Wx, if(4 == 0, fx + kx * grid, if(4 == px - 1, lx * grid + fx, kx * grid)))

name: wy0
expr: if(py == 1, Wy, if(0 == 0, fy + ky * grid, if(0 == py - 1, ly * grid + fy, ky * grid)))

name: wy1
expr: if(py == 1, Wy, if(1 == 0, fy + ky * grid, if(1 == py - 1, ly * grid + fy, ky * grid)))

name: wy2
expr: if(py == 1, Wy, if(2 == 0, fy + ky * grid, if(2 == py - 1, ly * grid + fy, ky * grid)))

name: wy3
expr: if(py == 1, Wy, if(3 == 0, fy + ky * grid, if(3 == py - 1, ly * grid + fy, ky * grid)))

name: wy4
expr: if(py == 1, Wy, if(4 == 0, fy + ky * grid, if(4 == py - 1, ly * grid + fy, ky * grid)))

name: cells: whole cells across times whole cells deep
fills the drawer across: cells x 42 mm + fillers = drawer width - clearance
fills the drawer deep: cells x 42 mm + fillers = drawer depth - clearance
plate starts at the origin across
plate starts at the origin deep
left filler is the computed one (at least 4 mm)
front filler is the computed one (at least 4 mm)
largest piece fits the bed across
largest piece fits the bed deep
the other pieces are no larger, and there are slots for all
no two parts overlap (pieces, clips and a seated bin foot)
a bin's foot seats on the socket's chamfers
a seated bin's straight sides stand 0.25 mm off the socket's
bowtie clips: one in the middle of every cell along every joint
bowtie clips: two half pockets for every clip
bowtie clips: the flanks at 36.87 deg (3:4), one per clip
bowtie clips: a half joint opens at most fit / 0.6 (0.25 mm at the default 0.15 mm fit)
bowtie clips: the gap round a clip has the volume of the pocket (the clip grown by the fit) less the clip
eq: if(bowtie && px > 1, btGap + 4 * gu * gv * 0.5 mm, 4 * gu * gv * (1.8 mm + clr + 0.5 mm))

name: bowtie clips: at least the fit from the pockets on every side, exactly the fit on the closest
dovetail tabs: one in the middle of every cell along every joint
dovetail tabs: the gap round a tab has the volume of the slot (the tab grown by the fit) less the tab
eq: if(dove && px > 1, dtGap + 2 * du * dv * 0.5 mm, 2 * du * dv * (max(1 mm, hb - 1.2 mm) + 0.5 mm))

name: dovetail tabs: at least the fit from the slots on every side, exactly the fit on the closest
bowtie pockets leave 0.8 mm round them (holes, windows, weight pocket, sockets and floor)
dovetail slots leave 0.8 mm round them (holes, windows, weight pocket, sockets and floor)
dw
label: Drawer width
description: The drawer's inside, left to right

name: dd
label: Drawer depth
description: The drawer's inside, front to back

name: fitD
label: Drawer clearance
description: How much smaller than the drawer the plate is, in total

name: bed
label: Print bed
description: The usable size of your printer's bed (the smaller side); the plate is split into pieces that fit it

name: style
label: Style
description: Light (8.3 mm): a 3.4 mm floor with a window in every cell; Solid (8.3 mm): a full 3.4 mm floor; Weighted (11.3 mm): a 6.4 mm bottom with a pocket for a weight under every cell; Thin (4.9 mm): the standard frame without a floor, lightest, but without magnets, screws or connectors (the floor carries those)

name: magnets
label: Magnet holes
description: 6.5 x 2.4 mm holes for 6 x 2 mm magnets in the four corners of every cell (not in the Thin style)

name: screws
label: Screw holes
description: A countersunk M3 hole in the middle of every cell, to screw the plate down (not in the Thin style)

name: conn
label: Connector
description: How the pieces lock together: bowtie clips pressed into pockets underneath, dovetail tabs on the joint edges, or none (the only choice for the Thin style)

name: clr
label: Connector fit
description: Play round a clip or a tab in its pocket, on every side

title: Gridfinity baseplate
description: A Gridfinity baseplate made to fill a drawer: give the drawer's inside and your print bed, and it fits as many 42 mm cells as it can, centred, with filler strips to the walls, split into pieces that fit the bed. The pieces lock together with bowtie clips pressed into pockets underneath, or with dovetail tabs. Light (windows in the floor), solid or weighted, with magnet holes and screw holes if you want. Every bin of the Gridfinity bin Jig seats in it. Export each piece and the clips (sets Print: pieces and Print: clips) as STL or 3MF. Gridfinity is by Zack Freedman (MIT).
author: 3DCraft Jigs
